cb04299a7e43793ad4a898ba7e46f4bc3163c4c0.summary: Appgate Labs analysed a new ransomware family called Egregor, which the report says seems to be a spin-off of Sekhmet. The group reportedly steals data, encrypts files, and threatens to leak data. The sample uses anti-analysis measures. A deep web leak site listed at least 13 companies, including logistics firm GEFCO, which the report says was attacked the week before.
